## Objective

Wrap the admitted Gale operator/PCG workspace with typed provider failure translation and a prior-plus-data preconditioner. Check the actual unpreconditioned residual and preserve convergence/breakdown/limit distinctions.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 3, 10, FA-07. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `Gale solver boundary adapter`
- `operator solver tests and probes`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Independent SPD systems and ill-conditioned/broken operators validate residuals, signs and iteration accounting.
2. No generic iterative solver is duplicated; ownership of returned mutable work views is contained.
3. Allocation and memory of repeated products/solves are measured; inexact solves produce only trial directions subject to original objective acceptance.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N03: FA-N03: Implement cached matrix-free projected-patch curvature and RHS
- G0: FA-G0: Admit the exact implementation baseline

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-N04: Qualify the Gale workspace PCG and preconditioner adapter
